<style>

/* ---------- ROOT PALETTE ---------- */
:root {
  --sand-light: #fdf3e7;
  --sand-mid: #f6e6d2;
  --sand-dark: #e9d2b3;
  --page-background-color: #f1dcc2;
  --terracotta: #8b3a2b;
  --terracotta-dark: #6f281b;
  --terracotta-light: #b5543c;
  --gold: #f4b942;
  --gold-soft: #ffd27a;
  --earth: #3a2d2a;
  --earth-soft: #5a4a46;
  --card-bg: rgba(255, 249, 241, 0.92);
  --card-border: rgba(122, 46, 29, 0.12);
  --header-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6f281b 0%, #7f2f22 45%, #9a5a2f 100%);
  --page-gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff7ef 0%, #f8ead8 45%, #f1dcc2 100%);
  --shadow-soft: 0 6px 18px rgba(58, 45, 42, 0.08);
  --shadow-hover: 0 10px 24px rgba(58, 45, 42, 0.14);
}

/* ============================================================
   GLOBAL
   ============================================================ */

body {
  background: var(--page-gradient);
  color: var(--earth);
}

.quarto-title-block {
  display: none;
}

main.content {
  max-width: 1500px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 3rem 4rem 3rem;
}


/* ============================================================
   HERO
   ============================================================ */

.research-hero {
  padding: 3rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  background: var(--header-gradient);
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(58, 45, 42, 0.2);
}

.hero-kicker {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--gold-soft);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.research-hero h1 {
  font-size: 3rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  margin: 0 0 0.8rem 0;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.research-hero p {
  max-width: 850px;
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #fff4e9;
  margin: 0;
}


/* ============================================================
   RESEARCH GRID
   ============================================================ */

.research-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
  align-items: stretch;
}


/* ============================================================
   RESEARCH CARDS
   ============================================================ */

.research-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  border-top: 4px solid var(--terracotta-dark);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 230px;
}

.research-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
  border-color: var(--terracotta-light);
}


/* ============================================================
   FEATURE CARD
   ============================================================ */

.research-card.feature {
  grid-column: span 2;
  min-height: 290px;
  padding: 1.75rem;
  background: var(--sand-dark);
  border-top-color: var(--terracotta-dark);
}

.feature-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  height: 100%;
}

.feature-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}

.feature-image {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.feature-image img {
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 245px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--sand-dark);
}


/* ============================================================
   CARD CONTENT
   ============================================================ */

.card-type {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  color: var(--terracotta-dark);
  margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
}

.research-card h2,
.media-card h2 {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin: 0 0 0.65rem 0;
  color: var(--earth);
}

.research-card p,
.media-card p {
  color: var(--earth-soft);
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  margin: 0 0 1.2rem 0;
}

.card-content {
  flex: 1;
}


/* ============================================================
   HYPERLINK
   ============================================================ */

.card-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  align-self: flex-start;

  background: var(--sand-mid);
  border: 1px solid var(--sand-dark);
  color: var(--terracotta-dark) !important;

  padding: 0.48rem 0.7rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-top: auto;

  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 650;

  text-decoration: none !important;

  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.card-button::after {
  content: " →";
  margin-left: 0.3rem;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.card-button:hover {
  background: var(--terracotta-dark);
  border-color: var(--terracotta-dark);
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

.card-button:hover::after {
  transform: translateX(4px);
}


/* ============================================================
   ICON / NUMBER
   ============================================================ */

.card-icon {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #f5ebe7;
  color: #7a2e1d;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;

  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}


/* ============================================================
   BOTTOM CARDS
   ============================================================ */

.bottom-card {
  min-height: 190px;
}


/* ============================================================
   MEDIA GRID
   ============================================================ */

.media-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
  margin: 1.25rem 0;
}


/* ============================================================
   MEDIA CARDS
   ============================================================ */

.media-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  border-top: 4px solid var(--terracotta);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.5rem;

  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

  min-height: 230px;

  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.media-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
  border-color: var(--terracotta-light);
}

.media-card:nth-child(2) {
  background: #fbf1e5;
  border-top-color: var(--earth-soft);
}

.media-card:nth-child(3) {
  background: #fff1d7;
  border-top-color: #b27a20;
}


/* ============================================================
   MEDIA ICON
   ============================================================ */

.media-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;

  background: #f1f5f9;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 700;

  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}


/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  main.content {
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .research-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .research-card.feature {
    grid-column: span 1;
  }

  .feature-inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .feature-image img {
    max-height: 220px;
  }

  .research-hero h1 {
    font-size: 2.3rem;
  }

  .media-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

}


@media (max-width: 600px) {

  main.content {
    padding: 1rem;
  }

  .research-hero {
    padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .research-hero h1 {
    font-size: 2rem;
  }

  .research-card,
  .media-card {
    padding: 1.25rem;
  }

}

</style>
